message: The other day, while I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we should have a little storm prep routine, they looked at me like I was talking in Morse code. "But why, Grandma?" they asked, as if I suggested we buy a pet alligator. I realized it’s all about making it fun for them—so we turned it into a scavenger hunt for flashlights and snacks instead. Who knew that prepping could be a way to bond? Have you had any silly moments with your family while getting ready for the unexpected?
